Name: Prestigious
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Prestige unlocks the day after Mastery 5 is obtained.

Each level in prestige adds a 1% sale price increase to produce sold.
Max prestige is 100

I may expand on this at a later date. (Lower sale price boost, give max hp/energy instead)



Values in the config.json:

[b]XPDivisor:[/b] Divides vanilla XP into Prestige XP (higher = slower leveling)
[b]XPPerEventCap:[/b] Max Prestige XP gained per action
[b]CurveA:[/b] Controls early/mid level XP scaling
[b]CurveB:[/b] Base value for late-game scaling
[b]CurveC:[/b] Growth rate of late-game scaling
[b]BonusPerLevel:[/b] Sell price increase per Prestige level
[b]MaxBonus:[/b] Maximum total sell price bonus
[b]MaxLevel:[/b] Auto-calculated from bonus settings (MaxBonus / BonusPerLevel)
[b]UnlockMasteryRequirement[/b]: Mastery levels required to unlock Prestige

I advise to not set "[b]UnlockMasteryRequirement[/b]" below actual mastery max level as draw patch is gated by this. 
If set lower than actual mastery then mastery bar will be replaced by prestige bar.
This will not break logical interaction but you will lose the ability to see mastery progress.
